title: wolfssl_rsa.c: RSA key import, sign, verify, generate, export
description:
Implement src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_rsa.c — the wolfssl crypto2dev provider for RSA-2048 and RSA-4096 PKCS#1 v1.5 sign/verify.

## Why this exists
DO_SIGN and DO_VERIFY ioctls return -EOPNOTSUPP for all RSA algos today because no provider sets the sign/verify callbacks. libwolfssl.ko exports all needed wc_Rsa* symbols.

## Algorithms to register
  'rsa-2048'  — key_import, sign, verify, key_generate, key_export_public, key_export_private
  'rsa-4096'  — same ops

## Context struct
  struct wolfssl_rsa_ctx {
      RsaKey  key;          /* wc_InitRsaKey_ex before use; wc_FreeRsaKey on free */
      WC_RNG  rng;          /* wc_InitRng_ex; wc_FreeRng on free */
      u32     key_type;     /* CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PRIVATE / _PUBLIC / _PAIR */
      bool    rng_inited;
      bool    key_inited;
  };

## key_import implementation
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. kzalloc ctx
  3. wc_InitRsaKey_ex(&ctx->key, NULL, INVALID_DEVID)
  4. If key_type == PRIVATE or PAIR:
       idx = 0; wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset(raw, &idx, rawlen)  -- skip PKCS#8 wrapper
       wc_RsaPrivateKeyDecode(raw + idx, &inner_idx, &ctx->key, rawlen - idx)
  5. If key_type == PUBLIC:
       idx = 0; wc_RsaPublicKeyDecode(raw, &idx, &ctx->key, rawlen)  -- SPKI DER
  6. wc_InitRng_ex(&ctx->rng, NULL, INVALID_DEVID); wc_RsaSetRNG(&ctx->key, &ctx->rng)
  7. FIPS 140-3: wc_RsaEncryptSize(&ctx->key) >= 256 (2048-bit minimum)

## sign implementation (PKCS#1 v1.5)
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. Verify key_type is PRIVATE or PAIR
  3. Construct DigestInfo DER from hash_algo + digest:
       SHA-256: 19-byte prefix (30 31 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 01 05 00 04 20) + 32-byte digest
       SHA-384: 19-byte prefix (30 41 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 02 05 00 04 30) + 48-byte digest
       SHA-512: 19-byte prefix (30 51 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 03 05 00 04 40) + 64-byte digest
  4. wc_RsaSSL_Sign(digest_info, digest_info_len, sig, sig_bufsz, &ctx->key, &ctx->rng)
  5. wc_RsaSSL_Sign returns positive byte count on success (signature length), 0 or negative on error
  6. Set *sig_len = ret on success

## verify implementation (PKCS#1 v1.5)
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. Allocate out buffer of wc_RsaEncryptSize(&ctx->key) bytes
  3. wc_RsaSSL_Verify(sig, sig_len, out, out_sz, &ctx->key) → returns recovered DigestInfo length
  4. Reconstruct expected DigestInfo for hash_algo+digest; memcmp with recovered output
  5. Return 0 if match, -EBADMSG if mismatch or wc error

## key_generate
  wc_MakeRsaKey(&ctx->key, key_bits, 65537, &ctx->rng)
  key_bits: 2048 for 'rsa-2048', 4096 for 'rsa-4096'

## key_export_public
  wc_RsaKeyToPublicDer(&ctx->key, out, bufsz) → returns DER length or negative

## key_export_private
  wc_RsaKeyToDer(&ctx->key, out, bufsz) → returns DER length or negative
  Only called when KEY fd was imported with exportable=1 (framework enforces)

## key_free
  if (ctx->rng_inited) wc_FreeRng(&ctx->rng)
  if (ctx->key_inited) wc_FreeRsaKey(&ctx->key)
  memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx))
  kfree(ctx)

## Error translation
  Static wolfssl_rsa_xlat_err(int wc_err) → kernel errno
  BAD_FUNC_ARG → -EINVAL, MEMORY_E → -ENOMEM, RSA_WRONG_TYPE_E → -EINVAL, etc.

## Registration
  Register 'rsa-2048' and 'rsa-4096' ops structs in wolfssl_provider.c algo_ops[] array

## Tests needed
  tests/userspace/test_rsa.c: KEY_IMPORT private → DO_SIGN → compare to known PKCS#1 v1.5 sig
  KEY_IMPORT public → DO_VERIFY → 0 on valid, -EBADMSG on tampered
notes:
DigestInfo DER prefixes (hardcoded, no ASN.1 library needed):
SHA-256 (19 bytes): 30 31 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 01 05 00 04 20
SHA-384 (19 bytes): 30 41 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 02 05 00 04 30
SHA-512 (19 bytes): 30 51 30 0d 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 03 05 00 04 40

wc_RsaSSL_Sign return: positive = bytes written (sig length), 0 or negative = error.
wc_RsaSSL_Verify return: positive = DigestInfo length recovered, negative = error.
Key import takes PKCS#8 DER (write-before-ioctl). Must call wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset to find inner PKCS#1 RSAPrivateKey offset. wc_RsaPublicKeyDecode handles SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER directly.
wolfssl_rsa_xlat_err needed: RSA_BUFFER_E→-ENOBUFS, BAD_FUNC_ARG→-EINVAL, MEMORY_E→-ENOMEM, BAD_PADDING_E→-EBADMSG, RSA_WRONG_TYPE_E→-EINVAL.
